title: How DNA on a glass of beer at airport led to capture of serial Australian rapist, the Night Stalker
summary: After more than three decades, breakthroughs in forensic technology resulted in NSW police arresting Glenn Gary Cameron in February 2024 Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast More than three decades ago the New South Wales police announced it had formed a special team to catch a man, later dubbed the “Night Stalker” or the “Moore Park rapist”, who terrorised women in the early 90s across Sydney. A poster with a sketched image of the man, based on one of his victim’s recollections, was also released. Below the image it said: “Do you know this person?
